mechanics.claim: Warwick gains bonus attack speed upon damaging a target to or while below 50% max health with a basic attack or ability damage, and the buff refreshes on subsequent qualifying damage.
mechanics.quote: gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for {{fd|1.25}} seconds upon damaging a target to or while they are below {{as|{{sti|health|50% of their '''maximum''' health}}}} with a basic attack or {{tip|ability damage}}, refreshing with subsequent damaging basic attacks or ability damage to enemies below the threshold

mechanics.claim: If Warwick does not already have the bonus attack speed, he also gains it upon initiating an attack windup against a target below the threshold (but this does not refresh an existing buff).
mechanics.quote: The initiation of the attack windup to gain the bonus attack speed is only for ''gaining'' the bonus; it does not refresh the duration of the attack speed buff if '''Warwick''' has it already.

mechanics.claim: Both the attack speed and movement speed bonuses are doubled against enemies below 25% max health.
mechanics.quote: The {{as|attack speed|attack speed}} and {{as|movement speed}} bonuses granted by both passives are doubled against enemies who are below {{as|{{sti|health|25% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}.

mechanics.claim: The active grants the passive attack speed and movement speed bonuses against the marked target regardless of that target's current health for the mark's duration.
mechanics.quote: '''Warwick''' senses the nearest enemy champion in the area at the start of the cast time, marking them with ''Blood Hunt'' for 8 seconds, gaining both passive bonuses against them regardless of their {{as|{{sti|health|'''current''' health}}}}.

mechanics.claim: Blood Hunt marks a target as sensed from wherever Warwick was at the start of the cast time, and if no enemy champion was found, it still goes on (reduced) cooldown without marking anyone.
mechanics.quote: If ''Blood Hunt'' was cast with no enemy champions within range, the ability incurs its cast time then goes on cooldown without marking any target.
